messages:
Renee (SRE): Postmortem follow-up from the throughput dip last Thursday. We saw sustained request backlog -> CPU queuing -> p95 up and throughput drop ~30% for ~15m windows. Looks recurring for the /chat route. Need owners for remediation + SLO update proposal.

Omar (Platform): Thanks. Two parts: short-term mitigation (traffic shaping, circuit breaker on heavy callers) and longer-term (edge request shaping + cache stabilization). What's the SLO proposal?

Renee (SRE): Proposal: introduce a composite SLO for public-hosted tier for 14 days: p95 <= 250ms AND 1m sustained throughput >= 85% of baseline (baseline = 1200 RPS). If combined condition fails for >3h in 7d, pause non-critical rollouts. Keep p99 as-is.

Lina (Service Owner): Composite SLO sounds useful but for enterprise customers we must maintain strict latency SLA. Can we scope throughput SLO to non-enterprise tenants?

Kai (Product): Agreed. Product will own customer impact mapping (which tenants count as enterprise). We'll also need a comms stub if we enable degraded paths.

Omar (Platform): I can implement a label-based throughput SLO filter and add a circuit-breaker rule: if per-key 1m throughput drop >40% and p95 > 400ms then throttle non-enterprise keys and divert 5% to quantized fallback. Expand to 15% if 24h burn remains high.

Renee (SRE): Action items: - Renee: Add composite SLO panels + burn-rate alerts to SLO dashboard (today) - Omar: Circuit-breaker + label routing + 5% fallback (today) - Lina: Enterprise tenant list + endpoints to exempt (2d) - Kai: Draft comms and customer-impact doc (tomorrow) - All: update postmortem tracker with owner+due dates (EOD)

ops-bot: Created calendar event "Throughput+SLO remediation checkpoint" Mon 09:45 PT. Alert group added: composite SLO burn-rate > 1.15 -> notify #eng-platform + oncall.

Omar (Platform): PromQL snippets I put in the PR for the dashboard: throughput per key: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/chat"}[1m])) by (api_key) and p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key)).

Lina (Service Owner): I'll work with Product to produce the enterprise list and mark which endpoints cannot be degraded. ETA 48h.

Renee (SRE): I've added a temporary playbook step: "on composite SLO breach -> enable circuit-breaker -> notify owners -> run 2h mitigation -> revert if stable". Also added CSV export of top callers to help product triage.

Kai (Product): I'll coordinate with sales to prepare the template for affected accounts. Also will publish a short FAQ for internal CS.

Omar (Platform): Opening PR for the routing changes and circuit-breaker config: https://git.internal/routing/PR-778. Feedback welcome.

Renee (SRE): We'll re-evaluate after first 48h mitigation window and decide on permanent fixes (edge shaping, request batching, connection pool tuning). Prefer not to relax SLAs unless absolutely required.

Lina (Service Owner): Noted. I'll add my action items to the tracker now.

Renee (SRE): Thanks everyone. I'll post the dashboard links and tracker link in this thread when done.
